first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon geometry for Devon County Council layer 669 ListEntry 1266928, with returned coordinates bound to record-level Name/type-use and Grade/heritage fields. The official layer metadata identifies layer 669 as an esriGeometryPolygon listed-buildings feature layer with ListEntry, Name and Grade fields and GeoJSON query support, but the distinct exact-record query response was not retrievable through the available public retrieval channel; the same metadata also warns that central Exeter records are out of date. No geometry, Name/type-use value or Grade was inferred, and no individual building record was accepted.
